source_dataset: FAO/WFP Special Report: Kosovo (2000 mission estimate)
source_scope: Kosovo under UNMIK; 2000 mission estimate; denominator uses Kosovo and Metohia territorial area
source_note: FAO/WFP estimated 297.5 thousand hectares of arable area in 2000 (Table 3). Converted to 2,975 km2 and divided by the 10,887 km2 territorial area reported for Kosovo and Metohia in the Statistical Yearbook of Yugoslavia 2001 (area attributed there to 1953 geodetic data). This is a one-year-earlier mission estimate, not a census or an exact FAOSTAT-compatible observation; the territory denominator includes any inland water.

source_dataset: Monstat plough-land and gardens; FAO FRA 2010 land-area denominator
source_scope: Montenegro; national land-use category; 2001 numerator divided by 2000 land-area denominator
source_note: Monstat reports 47,382 ha of plough-land and gardens for 2001. Dividing by the 1,345,000 ha land area reported by FAO FRA for 2000 gives 3.5228253%. The numerator is a 2001 national category that may not exactly match FAOSTAT arable land; the denominator is an adjacent-year FAO land-area measure. Keep the year and definition caveat in source-facing UI.

source_dataset: DGBAS Statistical Yearbook of the Republic of China 2020
source_scope: Taiwan Area; national forest-land definition; DGBAS reported land-area denominator
source_note: DGBAS reports 2,101,719 ha of forest land and 36,188.04 km2 land area for 2001; 2,101,719 ha / (36,188.04 km2 * 100 ha/km2) * 100 = 58.077724%. This is a national forest-land measure, not established as equivalent to the World Bank/FAOSTAT forest-area definition. The denominator differs from the CIA 2001 total/water tuple and from FAOSTAT land area; preserve it as a source-labeled national alternative.
